events.verdict: Officials stop play because they are not reasonably certain whether the ball touches the rim and thus whether the clocks should be adjusted. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is deemed that Turner's (IND) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim and the shot clock is reset to :06, which is the time the ball was possessed by Indiana following Turner's shot attempt failing to touch the rim. The clocks are reset and play resumes with Indiana's possession after the play is properly adjudicated by officials.
Coach Nurse (PHI) receives an unsportsmanlike technical foul.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) and Siakam (IND) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Gordon (PHI) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Haliburton's (IND) possession.
Nembhard (IND) extends a leg in Maxey's (PHI) path, initiating illegal leg contact that affects his shot attempt in the lane.
Drummond (PHI) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Nembhard (IND).
Siakam (IND) firms up in a screening position in Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) path and does not deliver contact.
Drummond (PHI) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Haliburton's (IND) possession.
Nesmith (IND) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
Haliburton (IND) gathers the ball and takes more than two steps before attempting the shot.

Oubre Jr. (PHI) is drawn towards Haliburton (IND) on the pump fake, but he contests to the side and lands in front of Haliburton before he jumps to shoot. Oubre Jr. would avoid making any lower body contact if not for Haliburton extending his legs to create the contact. When Oubre Jr.'s left arm is extended to the side, he grazes Haliburton's leg and the contact is marginal.
Nembhard (IND) maintains a legal guarding position during Maxey's (PHI) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) reaches in and initiates contact with Turner's (IND) arm, which affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Maxey (PHI) engages with Nembhard (IND) and the contact is marginal as he releases to receive the pass.
Nesmith (IND) maintains a legal guarding position during Maxey's (PHI) drive to the basket and shot attempt and the contact is incidental.
Siakam (IND) has a hand placed on Drummond's (PHI) arm as he jumps to pursue the rebound, but the contact does not affect Drummond's ability to tap the ball to a teammate.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of a defensive goaltending on Turner (IND) is confirmed. Turner touches the ball after it reaches its apex and is on its downward trajectory toward the basket with a chance to score.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Nembhard (IND) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Although the ball is last touched by Nembhard (IND) before going out of bounds, there is a proximate foul on the play when Maxey (PHI) follows through and initiates illegal contact to Nembhard's face before the ball goes out of bounds. Nembhard receives two free throws when play resumes.
Embiid (PHI) waves a towel on the bench in an attempt to disconcert the free throw shooter. A technical foul should have been assessed.
Nembhard (IND) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
Siakam (IND) commits a take foul on Oubre Jr. (PHI).
Oubre Jr. (PHI) commits a take foul on Nesmith (IND).
Maxey (PHI) lifts his arm upwards into Siakam's (IND) extended arm, but both players are able to move freely through the contact.
Nembhard (IND) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
Martin (PHI) commits a take foul on Haliburton (IND).
Haliburton (IND) crosses the plane of the free throw line before his free throw attempt contacts the rim.
Haliburton (PHI) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
